channel.title: The Ottawa Citizen - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Ottawa Citizen (ottawacitizen.com)

item.title: Experts call for a measles 'immunization action plan' in Ontario
item.description: The province last year experienced its largest measles outbreak in nearly three decades and Canada lost measles elimination status.

item.title: City closes deal on $95-million landfill near Carlsbad Springs
item.description: Residents have raised particular concerns about the suitability of the site given the abundance of Leda clay in the soil base

item.title: PSAC rallies at Parliament to protest public service job cuts
item.description: The Public Service Alliance of Canada says around 9,000 members have received notices that their jobs could be on the chopping block.

item.title: Sens 1-on-1: TSN's Jamie McLennan talks Sens struggling goaltending, playoff hopes, trade targets and more
item.description: Catchup with the latest episode of Sens 1-on-1 with Bruce Garrioch

item.title: Councillors support motion to fight for Kanata golf course greenspace
item.description: ClubLink is not obligated to run a golf course in perpetuity, the courts ruled, but councillors say there are other avenues to preserve the land as greenspace.

item.title: Engaged women's hockey players Ronja Savolainen, Anna Kjellbin on opposite teams at Olympics
item.description: Savolainen said she’s aware her story has drawn comparisons to the hit Canadian TV series Heated Rivalry, but her career in women’s hockey hasn’t been defined by the challenges faced by the fictional male players. “In women’s hockey, it’s more open to be gay and that kind of stuff."

item.title: Scarborough man charged with 2024 sex offences in Lanark County
item.description: The alleged offences date back to June 2024, the OPP said Wednesday.

item.title: Rebecca Leslie scores two late goals to complete Charge comeback in PWHL win over Seattle
item.description: Ottawa continued its upward swing with a dramatic victory over the Seattle Torrent at TD Place on Wednesday. The win improved the Charge's record to 4-5-0-7 for 22 points, two back of the PWHL's fourth and final playoff spot.

item.title: Ottawa Senators topple first-overall Colorado Avalanche with a 5-2 victory
item.description: The Senators played the kind of hockey that has made them successful some nights this season. They were relentless on the puck; they didn't allow the Avalanche many chances, and got key stops from goaltender James Reimer.

item.title: Senators player grades: Pinto shuts down MacKinnon, Cousins a force in 5-2 win over Avalanche
item.description: Shane Pinto's line held Nathan MacKinnon pointless, Nick Cousins was incredible, and James Reimer held down the fort as the Ottawa Senators played their most complete game of the season to defeat the Colorado Avalanche.
